Name: Granny's Recipe Box
Author: DuchessIvy
Description:
Granny Evelyn has a special talent, her magic, if you will. It's that she can make your favorite foods and they taste just like your mom/grandma/lola/tati/baba made it. Now she's sharing some of her secret recipes with you! Seven new recipes with gift tastes and some custom gift dialogue for vanilla Stardew NPCs.

Each recipe is sent in the mail once you've begun to befriend Granny Evelyn and the other villagers:
[list]
[*]Ramen, Ingredients: [spoiler]Rice noodles, any fish, bok choy, seaweed, any egg[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn and 2 hearts with Abigail[/spoiler]
[*]Hot Apple Cider, Ingredients: [spoiler]Apples x2, sugar, orange[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn and 2 hearts
with Leah[/spoiler][*]Macaroni and Cheese, Ingredients: [spoiler]Spring Onion, Wheat Flour, Any Milk, Cheese[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn, 2 hearts
with Sam and 2 hearts with Vincent[/spoiler][*]Shrimp Jambalaya, Ingredients: [spoiler]Shrimp x3, Hot Pepper, Oil, Rice[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn and 2 hearts
with Shane[/spoiler][*]Sbiten, Ingredients: [spoiler]Wine, honey, jelly[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn and 2 hearts
with Harvey[/spoiler][*]Congee, Ingredients: [spoiler]Common mushroom x2, Rice, Spring Onion[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn, 2 hearts with Emily and 2 hearts
with Haley[/spoiler][*]Atole de Zazamora (blackberry atole), Ingredients: [spoiler]Corn, Blackberry x5, Sugar, Any milk[/spoiler] Unlocks After: [spoiler]2 hearts with Evelyn and 2 hearts with Sebastian[/spoiler]
[/list]
This mod also adds Rice Noodles available for purchase at Pierre's! But not at 'the Jojamarts' as Granny Evelyn calls it.

If you notice any issues, please let me know in the posts or the bugs section! Most likely, I'll be posting a sequel to this mod at some point in the future with even more recipes and gift tastes. You can recommend any recipes you'd like to see, too!

I'm always open to adding compatibility, just message me either here on nexus or on discord! I'm DuchessIvy there, too.
